response.original_title: [Complete-Dispute] Disney Cruise Line Dispute Number: Customer Service & Resolution Guide
response.overview: You can contact Disney Cruise Line support and dispute resolutions in the US and Canada at (866) 254-7549. Contact Options & Details US and Canada Phone: (866) 254-7549 (Monday–Friday 8:00 AM – 10:00 PM, Saturday–Sunday 9:00 AM – 8:00 PM Eastern) Onboard Support: Visit the Guest Services Desk open 24 hours on your ship. Post-Cruise Feedback & Complaints: Email via the Disney Cruise Line Email Support (866) 254-7549 or mail written feedback to Disney Cruise Line Guest Communications, Post Office Box 10238, Lake Buena Vista, FL 32830.
